components.name: Product status row
components.description: Ruled list row with a filled square for live and a hollow square for pre-launch.

narrative.overview: A Hoffmann / Wiener Werkstatte showroom for one engineer's work: gallery-white walls, lacquer-black rules, hammered-silver hairlines, and nothing round. Every region of the page is a ruled square cell, and every control is a cell that fills solid black when it is active. The page is drawn, not decorated: the structure is the ornament. The only saturated color in the room is the real product screenshots, shown in framed windows. Dark mode inverts to lacquer black with light rules, same geometry.
keyCharacteristics: Zero radius everywhere; the form language is square, ruled and lattice-built.
Achromatic chrome (warm gallery white, black, silver); color arrives only through screenshots.
Josefin Sans light uppercase, letterspaced, for headings and labels; Hanken Grotesk for reading.
Active state is always a solid black fill with a color flip, never a glow or a lift.
Depth by rules: 1px black gap lattices and double-ruled cartouches, no shadows.
Hairline monogram drawn once, with a ruler-line stroke animation.

rules.name: The Product-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Saturated color appears only inside real product screenshots. Never add an accent hue, gradient or tinted fill to the chrome.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: Black rules (1px) divide structure; gray hairlines divide content inside a structure. Do not mix them in the same job.

rules.name: The Capitals-Are-Light Rule
rules.body: Josefin is uppercase and letterspaced at every size; display sizes stay at weight 200 to 300, small labels rise to 500 to 600 for legibility. Body copy is never uppercase and never Josefin.

rules.name: The Flat-Ruled Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. Separation is a 1px rule, a tonal step, or an offset outline; never a shadow, blur or glow.

dos: Do build every region as a ruled square cell; make lattices with a black container and `gap: 1px`.
Do make every active, hover or current state a solid Lacquer Black fill with Gallery White text.
Do set headings and labels in Josefin Sans uppercase with 0.05 to 0.22em tracking; read in Hanken Grotesk.
Do keep screenshots as the only saturated color, in a ruled frame on a mat.
Do switch theme only by reassigning the custom properties under `prefers-color-scheme: dark`.
Do reserve the pierced-square divider for the major turns of the page, and draw the monogram once.
Do respect `prefers-reduced-motion`: transitions collapse to near-zero and the monogram does not animate.
donts: Don't introduce border-radius, shadows, gradients, glass or glow.
Don't add an accent hue or color the chrome; no neon developer-portfolio dark mode.
Don't use a headline over a row of rounded cards (the white SaaS template).
Don't use filled rounded pill buttons or underlined text-only CTAs in place of a cell.
Don't mix lacquer rules and gray hairlines for the same division job.
Don't add em dashes as punctuation in copy.
